now.title: Runaways S1–S2#6
now.text: Janet has a long affair with Robert Minoru, which Victor exposes in public at the PRIDE gala.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Janet's lover in a long affair.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Robert's lover in a long affair.

proposed.title: Runaways S1–S2#1
proposed.text: Janet Stein is having a long, secret affair with Robert Minoru.

changes.evidence: The affair is already under way in the first episode (S1E1 'Reunion'): Janet takes a call from her lover Robert and arranges to see him at the PRIDE meeting. Victor only exposes it at the gala in S1E6 'Metamorphosis' (#6), so the stage starts too late, and the gala fact moves to its own stage (next entry).

proposed.title: Runaways S1–S2#6
proposed.text: Victor exposes Janet's affair with Robert Minoru in public at the PRIDE gala.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Janet's lover. Victor exposes their affair at the gala.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Robert's lover. Victor exposes their affair at the gala.

changes.evidence: S1E6 'Metamorphosis': at the PRIDE gala at Wizard Computers, Victor uses his speech to reveal Janet's affair with Robert in public. This is the split-off half of stage 0. (Janet ends the affair later in season 1, after this stage.)

now.title: Agent Carter S2#9
now.text: Whitney Frost kidnaps Jason Wilkes from Howard Stark's estate and forces him to help with her Zero Matter experiments. When their atomic test reopens the rift, it is Wilkes, not Frost, who absorbs the extra Zero Matter.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who kidnaps Wilkes for her Zero Matter experiments.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist Whitney kidnaps to help with her Zero Matter work.

proposed.title: Agent Carter S2#7
proposed.text: Whitney Frost breaks into Howard Stark's estate and kidnaps Jason Wilkes to use in her Zero Matter experiments.

changes.evidence: The kidnapping from Stark's estate happens in S2E7 'Monsters' (Ana lets Frost in, Frost knocks Wilkes out and Manfredi carries him off), and the atomic test that reopens the rift happens in S2E8 'The Edge of Mystery'. Neither is in S2E9. The stage moves to #7, and the rift test goes to its own stage (next entry). Frost first holds Wilkes at gunpoint over the Zero Matter back in S2E2.

proposed.title: Agent Carter S2#8
proposed.text: Whitney Frost talks Wilkes into helping her reopen the rift with an atomic test. When it opens, it is Wilkes, not Frost, who absorbs the extra Zero Matter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The woman whose rift test fills Wilkes with Zero Matter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist who absorbs the Zero Matter Whitney wanted from the rift.

changes.evidence: S2E8 'The Edge of Mystery': Wilkes agrees to work with Frost; at the desert atomic test the rift opens, and only Wilkes is pulled in and comes back with more Zero Matter, to Frost's fury. Split-off half of stage 0.

now.title: Agatha All Along#8
now.text: Rio Vidal walks the Witches' Road with Jennifer Kale as the coven's Green Witch before revealing that she is Death.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The coven's Green Witch on the Road, who turns out to be Death.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A witch Rio walks the Road with, before revealing herself as Death.

proposed.title: Agatha All Along#4
proposed.text: Rio Vidal is summoned as the coven's new Green Witch and walks the Witches' Road with Jennifer Kale.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The coven's Green Witch on the Road.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A witch Rio walks the Road with.

changes.evidence: Rio joins the coven as the replacement Green Witch in episode 4, after Sharon's death, so the walk on the Road starts at #4, not #8. Her identity as Death is first found out by Lilia in episode 7 and shown to Agatha in episode 8; Jen is never shown learning it from Rio. Since that fact is later than #4, it comes out of this stage (it could be its own stage at #7 or #8 if wanted).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#6
now.text: Eli Morrow and Lucy Bauer were colleagues at Momentum Labs. He arranged the attack that left her a ghost, and she later takes him hostage.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Former Momentum colleague Eli made a ghost. Takes him hostage.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Former Momentum colleague who made Lucy a ghost. She takes him hostage.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#5
proposed.text: Eli Morrow and Lucy Bauer were colleagues at Momentum Labs until he betrayed her in the experiment that turned her into a ghost. She takes him hostage during the South Ridge prison riot.

changes.evidence: Lucy kidnaps Eli during the South Ridge Penitentiary riot in S4E5 'Lockup' and forces him to read the Darkhold. S4E6 only shows the flashback. Also, Eli did not 'arrange an attack' on her: he struck her and locked her in the Quantum Particle Generator himself (the Fifth Street Locos hit was Joseph Bauer's doing). The ghosts already blame Eli in S4E2.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#15
now.text: Jemma Simmons gets Piper out of the Playground before Aida's decoys destroy it and puts her on Zephyr One's guns.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Jemma saves from the Playground and puts on Zephyr One's guns.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist who gets Piper out of the Playground before it falls.

proposed.text: Jemma Simmons wakes Piper at gunpoint during Aida's takeover and shows her she is not a decoy. Piper helps get the agents out of the Playground before it is blown up.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Jemma wakes and gets out of the Playground before it falls.

changes.evidence: In S4E15 'Self Control', Simmons wakes Piper and orders her out at gunpoint; Piper nearly stabs her until she sees Mack's LMD torn apart, then evacuates agents to Zephyr One before May's LMD blows up the base. Simmons putting Piper on Zephyr One's guns happens later, in S4E21, after Jemma leaves the Framework.

now.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
now.text: The Scarlet Witch breaks into the base where Christine holds America and chases them through its tunnels. At the Book of Vishanti she throws Christine and Stephen into a dying universe.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hunts Christine and throws her into a dying universe.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Earth-838's Christine. The Scarlet Witch throws her into a dying universe.

proposed.text: The Scarlet Witch attacks the Illuminati's base, where Christine works, and Christine helps Stephen and America escape through its tunnels. At the Book of Vishanti, Wanda throws Christine and Stephen into a dying universe.

changes.evidence: Christine does not hold America. Strange and America are brought before the Illuminati by Mordo. After Wanda kills the Illuminati, Earth-838's Christine, a scientist working with them, helps the two escape.

now.title: Loki S1#1
now.text: Casey is the TVA clerk who processes Loki on arrival and shows him a drawer of Infinity Stones used as paperweights.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A variant Casey processes on arrival and shows the drawer of Infinity Stones.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA clerk who processes Loki and shows off Infinity Stones as paperweights.

proposed.text: Casey files the Tesseract taken from Loki as evidence. When Loki threatens to kill him for it, Casey hands it over, and Loki finds a drawer of Infinity Stones that Casey says some workers use as paperweights.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A variant who threatens Casey for the Tesseract and finds the drawer of Infinity Stones.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA clerk who hands over the Tesseract and says Infinity Stones serve as paperweights.

changes.evidence: In S1E1, B-15 hands the Tesseract to Casey, who files it as evidence; he does not process Loki. Loki later threatens to 'gut him like a fish', Casey opens the evidence drawer and gives it up, and Loki sees the Infinity Stones; Casey says some employees use them as paperweights. He does not show them off.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#14
now.text: Doctor Octopus leads the Insidious Six, the Scorpion among them, against Spider-Man.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Scorpion's leader in the Six.

proposed.text: Doctor Octopus and the Scorpion are both members of the Insidious Six, the team Kingpin breaks out of prison to destroy Spider-Man.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow member of Kingpin's Insidious Six.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow member of Kingpin's Insidious Six.

changes.evidence: In 'The Insidious Six' (#14), Kingpin springs and assembles the six villains. Sources name Kingpin as the team's founder and leader, with Doctor Octopus and the Scorpion as members 'under command of the Kingpin'. None names Doctor Octopus as leader.

owner_calls.question: Stage 0 (Loki S1#1) has kind 'ally', but in that episode Loki is a TVA prisoner who threatens to kill Casey to get the Tesseract back. Keep 'ally', or change it?
options: Keep ally (Casey is TVA staff and becomes an ally later)
Change to enemy for S1#1 (they become allies from S2#2)
owner_calls.evidence: S1E1: Loki threatens to gut Casey like a fish unless he hands over the Tesseract. Casey complies and Loki escapes with the Time Twister.
